_comment: Batch Analysis, native emtk window. One panel per wizard step, drawn by emtk.view_form over BatchModel (gui/model.py); 'navigation' is the Back / Next / Finish bar. Same steps, titles and fields as the Qt wizard (../batch.view.json).
title: Batch Analysis

sections.title: Navigation
sections.name: navigation
sections.description: Walk the steps in order: Back, Next, and Finish on the last step.
Back goes to the previous step, Next to the following one and Finish (last step only) closes the wizard.

buttons.label: Back
buttons.description: Go to the previous step. Not available on the first step.

buttons.label: Next
buttons.description: Go to the following step. Every step can be visited in any order.

buttons.label: Finish
buttons.description: Close the wizard. The results stay in the CSV, DOCX and ZIP files that were written.

sections.title: Welcome
sections.name: welcome
sections.description: What a batch analysis does and what to prepare before it.
The introduction to the batch analysis.

sections.title: Loaded data
sections.name: datasets
sections.description: Datasets already loaded in ChiSurf that join the batch. Optional.

sections.title: Loaded datasets
sections.description: Every dataset loaded in ChiSurf. Tick the ones to fit with the template; they run before the files.

columns.title: Use
columns.tooltip: Tick to include the dataset in the batch.

columns.title: Dataset
columns.tooltip: Number and name of the loaded dataset; hover a row for its file.

sections.description: How many datasets are ticked, or why the list is empty.
Re-scan the datasets loaded in ChiSurf.

buttons.label: Refresh
buttons.description: Re-scan the datasets currently loaded in ChiSurf; ticks of datasets that are still there are kept.

sections.title: Files & fit
sections.name: files
sections.description: Files to load and fit, and the template fit whose parameters seed every run.

sections.title: Files to process
sections.description: Files that are loaded one by one and fitted after the loaded datasets. Drop files or folders on the window to add them.

columns.title: File
columns.tooltip: File name; hover a row for its full path.

sections.description: Add files, a folder or a database dataset; remove the selected file or clear the list.

buttons.label: Folder
buttons.description: Add a folder (every file below it, scanned recursively).

buttons.label: Database
buttons.description: Select a dataset from the MMFDB database (including S3-backed object stores).

buttons.label: Remove
buttons.description: Remove the selected file from the list (the file itself is not deleted).

sections.label: Template fit
sections.description: The pre-optimised fit whose parameters seed every run.
List the fits of ChiSurf again.

buttons.label: Refresh fits
buttons.description: List the fits that exist in ChiSurf now (the list is read when this step opens).

sections.title: Run
sections.name: run
sections.description: Choose where to save the results, then run the batch.
What the batch will run: datasets, files and the template fit.

sections.label: Results CSV
sections.description: Destination CSV. A DOCX report and a ZIP of per-run exports are written alongside.
Choose the CSV file, and run the batch.

buttons.label: Browse...
buttons.description: Choose where to save the results CSV.

buttons.label: Run batch
buttons.description: Run the template fit over every selected dataset/file.

sections.description: How many items of the batch are fitted.
The outcome of the last run: written files, or what went wrong.

sections.title: Results
sections.name: results
sections.description: Per-parameter results of the last run.
The outcome of the last run: written files, or what went wrong.

sections.title: Results of the last run
sections.description: One row per item and parameter, as written to the CSV.

columns.title: Run
columns.tooltip: Position of the item in the queue (loaded datasets first, then files).

columns.title: Filename
columns.tooltip: Dataset name or file path of the item.

columns.title: Fixed
columns.tooltip: Yes when the parameter was held fixed in the template.

columns.title: Chi2r
columns.tooltip: Reduced chi-square of the fit; a jump marks a sample the template does not describe.
